The Mens 10000m was dominated and won by Roger Alsop showing great confidence after a fine p.b. in the Surrey Championships two weeks earlier.

However, there was some encouraging improvement made by several of our younger runners such as Jonathon Hobbs, Owen Lewis, Roger Alsop etc., as well as good support as usual from our growing band of New Zealanders.
The highlight of this low key part one of the Surrey Track and Field Championships was Frank Ward's bronze medal in the 10,000 metres with Roger Alsop in 6th place passing the '5000' mark in a pb.
With a number of younger distance runners such as John Hobbs, Owen Lewis, Roger Alsop, Chris Millbank and others all steadily improving, the future looks quite hopeful.
